Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! Kasun Rajitha has the ball in his hand while Rahmanullah Gurbaz and  Ibrahim Zadran are the two openers in the middle.
... THE RUN CHASE ...

For the visitors it was Fazalhaq Farooqi who started the fireworks dismissing Dimuth at the top. Fazalhaq Farooqi and Fareed Ahmad scalped a couple and he was well helped by Mujeeb Ur Rahman, Noor Ahmad,  Azmatullah Omarzai and Mohammad Nabi who scalped a wicket each. The target is a decent one looking at the condition of the pitch this target would take some chasing. Join us in a bit for the chase.

After being asked to bat first the islanders started in a cautious manner after losing Dimuth Karunaratne early on. Pathum Nissanka batted well and fought hard before perishing on a score of 38. Charith Asalanka was the stand-out batter as he batted extremely well and managed to score 91 runs. Dhananjaya de Silva along with Charith Asalanka stabled the ship just when it was crumbling at 84 for 4, the partnership of 99 runs helped the hosts to post this total.

We are at the halfway of this game as the hosts Sri Lanka post a total of 268 runs for the loss of 10 wickets after 50 overs. The hosts did well in the middle overs but they could not get that big finish as they kept losing wickets in the end. However, the game is still nicely poised at the break.

OUT! RUN OUT! Sri Lanka have been bowled out on the last ball of their innings then. Azmatullah Omarzai serves this full and on off, Matheesha Pathirana pushes it towards extra covers and sets off for the run but Hashmatullah Shahidi there pick up and throws at the bowler's end where Azmatullah Omarzai does the rest. The replay shows that Matheesha Pathirana is well shot of the crease. Sri Lanka finishes on 268!

Pathum Nissanka and Dimuth Karunaratne are the two openers for Sri Lanka. Fazalhaq Farooqi has the new ball in his hand and is raring to go. Let's play...
We are moments away from the game but before that, the players line up for their respective national anthems. It will be Afghanistan's first followed by the national anthem of Sri Lanka.

Dasun Shanaka, the captain of Sri Lanka says that he would have bowled first but the deck looks really nice and they are happy to bat. Adds the experience of Dimuth Karunaratne will help at the top and they are looking forward to it. Mentions that Dushan Hemantha and Matheesha Pathirana are the two debutants for them.

Hashmatullah Shahidi (Afghanistan Skipper) says they would like to bowl first. He adds that the wicket looks fresh and it will help the bowlers in the first hour and so. He also adds that the exclusion of Rashid is a big miss but the team does not lack quality and they are pumped up for this. He closes by saying that the team is constantly improving and they are up for it this time around.

Afghanistan have won the toss and they have decided to bowl first.

The visitors Afghanistan are on a roll and they would be looking at this as a perfect preparation for the supreme tournament on the horizon. The exclusion of Rashid for the first couple of games would be a big miss for the visitors but they would count on Mohammad Nabi and Mujeeb Ur Rahman to guide Noor Ahmad swiftly settle into the ODI format from the shorter version of the game. Rahmanullah Gurbaz is expected to lead the batting unit along with the Zadran brother and stand-in skipper Hashmatullah Shahidi. The key battle would be between the spin bowling of the hosts against the stable-looking batting unit of the visitors. Stay updated for the toss and team news.

Sri Lanka is stepping into this game with a really positive mindset and would be looking to come up with a combination they could trust with the ICC World Cup Qualifiers in their sights. The hosts are stepping into this series with big names like Angelo Mathews and Dimuth Karunaratne in the side. Sadeera Samarawickrama has also been called up to the squad after a big gap of four years. Young gun Matheesha Pathirana has been called up after an impressive outing in the Indian T20 League where he shone under the leadership of M.S. Dhoni and won the title recently. He and Dushmantha Chameera will be a real test for the Afghanistan batters today. Wanindu Hasaranga is fit and would be leading the side in the spin bowling department.
